roles.orchestrator: Coordinate the same task and linked graph; no self-granted implementation, review or release authority.
roles.implementor: Implement and revise the concept in its owned worktree; request independent native same-card SPEC review.
roles.spec-reviewer: Independently review the exact frozen revision against scope and invariants, without editing it.
roles.quality-security-reviewer: Independently review correctness, quality and security after SPEC passes; do not implement fixes.
roles.integrator: Reconcile accepted changes, deploy shared DEV, and publish only the exact task delta after separate final authority.
roles.e2e-tester: Independently test the exact deployed shared DEV revision and verify the actual production result; no code fixes or promotion.
